column1: # The upstreams the themes are ported from, each pinned to the commit it was
# ported at: name, repository, commit or tag, and for a large repository the
# one directory to check out. tools/fetch-upstreams.sh checks each out in
# .upstream/NAME; tools/port-themes.el ports from there and records the
# commit, and the version and authors the theme's files declare, in
# sources.json; tools/check-upstreams.py says which have changed since.
